  • Use 'on' to talk about particular days, dates, and holidays such as:

  • ​For the most specific times or places, and for holidays without the word “day,” we use 'at' such as:
    • at midnight, at noon, at 7 pm, at home, at the office, etc.
  • As a location i.e. 'restaurants' is given, 'in' will be used in the blank part of the sentence.
     

 ​​​​Additional Information  ​

  • There are certain phrases/nouns which are not preceded by a preposition (especially 'on').
  • Some of them are given below:
    • today, tomorrow, yesterday, the next day/month/year, tonight, last night, etc.
  • Example:​
    • I met her on last Saturday. 
    • I met her last Saturday.

Key Points 
  • The sentence states that saltwater crocodiles are also known as estuarine crocodiles "as they (1)_____________ to live in mangrove lined rivers."

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 4.

They’re the (2)_________________ living reptile, reaching up to seven metres in length: far larger than Indonesia’s famous Komodo dragon, which tops out at three metres. (3)______________________, crocodiles lived throughout the Indonesian archipelago. We have (4)_________________ of attacks on humans in Bali from the early 20th century and across much of Java until the 1950s. Even Indonesia’s capital, Jakarta, had crocodile’s (5)____________________in many rivers running through the city.
